symbols.name: DEFAULT_BUSY_TIMEOUT_MS
symbols.note: Default SQLite busy timeout in milliseconds, set to 30000.

symbols.name: SpineError
symbols.note: Base exception for ledger errors, inherits RuntimeError.

symbols.name: UnknownIntent
symbols.note: Exception for non-existent intent, inherits SpineError.

symbols.name: IntentAlreadyResolved
symbols.note: Exception for already resolved intent, inherits SpineError.

symbols.name: _now_iso
symbols.note: Returns current UTC time as ISO 8601 string.

symbols.name: _uri_path
symbols.note: Converts filesystem path to SQLite URI path part, escaping backslashes, '?' and '#'.

symbols.name: default_db_path
symbols.note: Returns path to ledger database, overridable via DAEDALUS_SPINE_DB env var.

symbols.name: Intent
symbols.note: Dataclass representing a recorded intent with current state and derived ITE-6 statement.

symbols.name: Intent.is_open
symbols.note: Returns True if state is STATE_INTENDED.

symbols.name: Intent.to_statement
symbols.note: Returns ITE-6 statement dict from intent data.

symbols.name: IntentEvent
symbols.note: Dataclass for an intent event with id, intent_id, state, ts, detail.

symbols.note: Tuple of SQL CREATE TABLE statements for schema initialization.

claims.text: Hold rather than surfacing "database is locked" to the loop.
claims.why: The comment refers to the purpose of DEFAULT_BUSY_TIMEOUT_MS but no code using it is shown in this chunk.

claims.text: Backslashes are not URI separators, and ?/# would start the query and fragment -- on Windows all three turn up in real paths.
claims.why: The function replaces backslashes with forward slashes, and escapes '?' and '#' as %3f and %23.

claims.text: DAEDALUS_SPINE_DB overrides it (tests and isolated worktrees point this away from the real runs/ directory).
claims.why: The function checks the env var and returns Path(env) if set, else DEFAULT_DB_PATH.

claims.text: PROCESS-GLOBAL by design -- the counterpart, and deliberately NOT the same question, is daedalus.spine.picker.resolve_spine_db_path, which is repo-confined and ignores this env var so that picking for a foreign repository can never be redirected by inherited environment.
claims.why: References to daedalus.spine.picker.resolve_spine_db_path and its behavior are not present in this chunk.

claims.text: payload_json is the exact text stored in the row (not a re-render), so a caller can digest or diff it without guessing the serialisation.
claims.why: The payload_json field is declared but no code in this chunk guarantees it is stored exactly; it's a claim about storage behavior.

claims.text: Last field and defaulted, so every existing keyword construction of Intent still type-checks and still runs.
claims.why: trace_id has no default value in the dataclass definition; it is typed as str | None but not defaulted. Keyword constructions must provide it explicitly or it will be required.

claims.text: This intent as an in-toto ITE-6 statement. A PROJECTION, not storage.
claims.why: The method returns a dict but no ITE-6 statement structure is validated; the claim about projection vs storage is about usage not code.

claims.text: The row remains the source of truth and the payload column is never wrapped -- callers reach intent.payload and intents_matching_payload's substring search both depend on the stored text staying exactly what it was.
claims.why: No reference to intents_matching_payload or storage behavior in this chunk.

claims.text: The subject digest is the STORED payload_sha, not a recomputation: re-hashing here would silently repair the one disagreement worth surfacing -- a stored digest that no longer matches its stored payload.
claims.why: The method uses self.payload_sha directly without recomputing it, consistent with the claim.

claims.text: Written once, never updated. Everything that changes lives in the events
claims.why: The comment describes a table property but the schema is incomplete in this chunk; no enforcement shown.

observations.what: Intent.trace_id field lacks default value despite docstring claiming it is defaulted.
_uri_path only escapes '?', '#', and backslashes; other URI-unsafe characters are not percent-encoded.
default_db_path returns Path(env) without checking if env is a valid path; could be empty string leading to current directory.
Intent.to_statement does not recompute payload_sha; relies on stored value.
_SCHEMA definition is incomplete; only first two statements are shown.
